docTitle: Pail · Desktop manager for S3-compatible storage
docDescription: Pail is a free, open-source desktop manager for Amazon S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 and any service that speaks the S3 API, for Windows, Linux and macOS.
heroSub: A desktop manager for Amazon S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2 and any service that speaks the S3 API. Free and open source, for Windows, Linux and macOS.
shotAlt: Pail main window with the bucket list, an object table and the inspector
featuresTitle: Everything a bucket needs, in one window.
fTransfersBody: Separate upload and download queues with progress, speed, cancel and retry. Multipart uploads, checksums and conflict policies; a download lands on disk only after it is verified.
fPaletteBody: Press Ctrl K, or ⌘K on macOS, to search every command, bucket and tool, in English or Chinese.
fSettingsTitle: 14 bucket settings, as forms or JSON
fSettingsBody: Versioning, encryption, policy, CORS, lifecycle, replication and more. When a provider lacks a setting, Pail says it is unsupported instead of showing it as empty.
fVersionsBody: See every version of a key, restore an old one or undelete a key, and permanently delete only the versions you pick.
fSyncTitle: Sync that shows its plan first
fSyncBody: Upload, download or mirror; compare by size and time, size, or checksum; exclude by glob. Only previewed actions run, and local deletions go to the system trash.
fLinksBody: Presigned GET or PUT URLs with an expiry, for one object or many. Add a CDN domain to an account and copy CDN links right after an upload.
fRulesBody: Match a bucket and key pattern to set headers, storage class and encryption, or compress with GZIP, ZIP or AES-256 ZIP on the way up.
cliTitle: The same accounts, in your terminal.
cliBody: pail shares accounts and saved sync jobs with the desktop app. It prints JSON on request, returns stable exit codes and never prints credentials.
pKeysBody: Secret keys go to Windows Credential Manager, macOS Keychain or Secret Service, or to an optional vault encrypted with Argon2id and XChaCha20-Poly1305.
pNetBody: Pail connects only to the endpoints of the accounts you add.
pLogBody: When you turn the diagnostic log on, signatures, authorization headers, query strings and known secrets are removed.
pScopeBody: Destructive actions show what they will touch first. Deleting a bucket requires typing its name.
dlgConfirm: Type the bucket name to confirm
osLinuxReq: pail-desktop, pail, a .desktop entry and an icon in a .tar.gz
osMacReq: Pail.app and pail in a .zip · macOS 11 or later
downloadNote: Archives are not code-signed. The macOS app is not notarized and has not yet been tested on a real Mac.
demoHint2: to try Pail on a built-in in-memory S3 server. Nothing leaves your machine.
